description: Cancel one resting order by market and order index. Read the order index from lighter_account with a market selector.

market_id.description: Market id, for example 182 for H100. Use this or symbol.

order_index.description: Exchange-assigned order index, as a decimal string. It exceeds the safe integer range, so pass it exactly as lighter_account reported it.

symbol.description: Market ticker, for example H100. Use this or market_id.

name: lighter_cancel
title: Cancel a Lighter order
